findings.reason: The standalone original tile shows only formulas and prose. A coordinate-strip picture materially clarifies the central geometric failure: the two one-dimensional manifolds share an open orbit and hence the same tangent direction, despite the ambient surface having a second direction. This is warranted explanatory content even though the complete proof is already independent.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The chart is a coordinate strip in the torus parameter coordinates (u,v); the blue horizontal segment represents the closure of gamma={(u,pi): pi/2<u<3pi/2}.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Witness gives the regular torus parameterization, and step 1.1 gives the diagonal positive metric. The caption explicitly excludes critical endpoints from gamma and explicitly limits the figure to a strip rather than the whole torus.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The marked endpoints are a=(pi/2,pi), b=(3pi/2,pi), both saddles; p is an interior point.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.2 identifies both saddles and step 2.1 fixes the open interval. The two endpoints are shown distinctly from the interior marked point.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Forward arrows on gamma go in increasing u, from a toward b.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.1 restricted to v=pi gives du/dt=-cos(u)/(R-r); on pi/2<u<3pi/2 it is positive. Step 2.1 establishes backward limit a and forward limit b, matching the descending-flow stable/unstable conventions in both local supplier definitions.

diagram_math_checks.relation: gamma is contained in W^u(a) intersect W^s(b); their tangent lines at p coincide with R partial_u.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 2.1 proves the stated limit membership and local branch coincidence; step 3.1 gives the tangent equality. One shared horizontal segment depicts this coincidence; no transverse crossing of these two manifolds is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The vertical arrow at p denotes partial_v, a second ambient surface-coordinate direction, not another stable/unstable branch.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.1 gives g=A^2 du^2+r^2 dv^2 with A>0 and r>0, so partial_u and partial_v are nonzero independent coordinate directions. Its label and caption specify this meaning.

diagram_math_checks.proof: The rigorous proof remains independent of the illustration; all original proof text and tags are unchanged.
